scope: Unaveraged vector and scalar MeasurementSet model ratios, with independent column selectors, axis-specific projection, corrected fallback and zero-model samples. The finite-input extremes cover float overflow and underflow and overflow during phase conversion.
baseline_result: CASA exported 12 selected points for the implicit vector ratio. casa-rs refused the independent derived column selectors.
precision_baseline_result: Before the precision fix, the native vector ratio returned 4.47214e38 and 26.5651 degrees where CASA returned inf and 0 degrees. CASA also reports inf when the intermediate Float multiplication by 180 overflows during phase conversion.
